conflicts: GA's 2 mm capsule and 85 micrometre wall are rounded outreach values. The experiment paper specifies a 1.05 mm inner radius and 8 + 15 + 63 micrometre sublayers, giving a nominal 2.272 mm outer diameter and 86 micrometre wall.
LLNL's general targets page describes a 9 × 5 mm hohlraum. This is not the 11.24 × 6.4 mm N221204 baseline.
The complete pre-shot exterior of the specific December 2022 assembly has not been verified photographically. Generic intact hardware supplies visual context only.
limitations: Original educational reconstruction from published geometry; not LLNL or General Atomics production CAD.
Outer hohlraum wall, lining thickness, tube bore, glue, support contours, cooling rings, arms, shields, heaters and windows include explicitly estimated dimensions.
Suspension thickness is published; the conical support contours and contact positions are illustrative.
Smooth nominal surfaces contain no measured defects, crystal grains or invented nanoscale roughness.
Static pre-shot geometry only. No implosion, laser-drive calculation, manufacturing validation or power-plant performance prediction.
Chamber ports, target-bay machinery and actual positioner mechanisms are omitted; chamber dimensions provide scale context.
